hints.title: Sort by Hero Strength
hints.text: Sorting nums guarantees that in any subset ending at index i, nums[i] is the maximum element.

hints.title: Contribution of Minimums
hints.text: For a fixed maximum nums[i], the minimum element nums[j] (j < i) appears in 2^(i - 1 - j) subsets.

hints.title: Running Prefix Contribution
hints.text: Maintain a running sum S = 2 * S + nums[i - 1] so that the total minimum contribution is S + nums[i] in O(1).

hints.title: Sorted Contribution Accumulator Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def sumOfPower(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        nums.sort()
        ans = 0
        s = 0
        for x in nums:
            ans = (ans + (x * x % MOD) * (s + x)) % MOD
            s = (2 * s + x) % MOD
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by linear pass maintaining weighted prefix sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating 2^n subsets explicitly is impossible for n = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts to fix max element and derives linear recurrence for min contributions.
